card.name: The word at before increased risk
card.fires_on: The word "at" right after "are" or "be" when a group of patients is described, just before "increased risk" or "greater risk". Seen in warning text about who is more likely to develop a problem.

modes.label: Patients are at risk
modes.description: "at" follows a patient group and a form of "to be", setting up "increased risk" of a condition.
modes.example: Patients receiving FABHALTA are<< at>> increased risk for invasive disease caused by encaps

modes.label: Women or fetuses at risk
modes.description: "at" follows "may be" for a vulnerable group in a warning heading.
modes.example: Women and their fetuses may be<< at>> increased risk. Monitor more frequently and adjust

card.writes: It boosts the word risk and its variants (including Chinese forms), predicting that "risk" comes next.
card.plain: It fires on "at" in phrases like "patients are at increased risk", where the next word will be risk.
